text_block_list.text:
Summer camp was finally in its final stretch.
While working hard on finishing touches
with K.S.Miracle—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
TOOOOOOOHHHHH!!!!
BAKUSHIN BAKUSHIIIIIIIN!!!!
(DADADADADADADADA!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa, phew...! Great work, Bakushin O...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, that's amazing...!
Your time got even faster...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahaha! That's wonderful to hear!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, not yet!!
Next time, I'll zoom right past you too, Flower-san,
and leave you completely in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, one more time! Bakushin, bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
! M-Me too...!
I'm not going to lose just yet...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"*pant*, *wheeze*... No, please, give me a break...
You two are way too fast...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Flower-chan definitely feels like a true genius girl, or rather, an Oka Sho champion Umamusume, but—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Class Rep Bakushin's been pretty wild lately~...
I mean, pulling off that kind of speed on sand? For real, what is she??

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The way Class Rep Bakushin is right now,
she looks like she could run right over the ocean... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The fastest!! The strongest!!
Bakushin Bakushiiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Baku... shin... Baku...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whew――――!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Ngggh... HNNGH!!!
I'm not done, not yet!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Good work. Have you had enough water?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Well, well!
Thank you very much, Miracle-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah!!
Nothing beats hydration after a good Bakushin!!
And it was a gift from Miracle-san, too!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The thoughtful kindness of a refreshing yet fiery rival has truly warmed me to the core!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Rivals—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So you call me that,
too, huh?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Bakushin O.
And also—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Let's settle this.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry I couldn't give you a proper answer the other day.
I want to tell you properly now."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: You told me that I was faster 'for now'. And that you'd overturn that in the future.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that is my intention!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...But, I won't let that happen.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I have legs I can be proud of.
Legs given to me by everyone,
and nurtured by my Trainer—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I have these legs—faster than anyone, second to none.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"That's why.
—I'm gonna be the fastest in this era."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Let's settle this... at the Sprinters Stakes, Sakura Bakushin O."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!!
...Bwahahahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!!
After exchanging such a passionate declaration... K.S.Miracle returned to me with a somewhat light, floating step.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um... How was that just now, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... was that too provocative?
Or rather...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I-I wonder. Did I... come across as a bit unpleasant, maybe...?"
choice_data_list: No, I thought you looked really cool!
No, I thought you looked cool!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...!
Really? I see...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that makes me happy.
So I looked 'cool,' huh...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if I really became like that,
it's all thanks to you, Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Confident and cool.
If that's what I've truly become...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Let's see. For example...
Just like how eating a huge meal made with love
gives you strength from the inside out.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The days I spent with you...
are what gave me confidence.
